The ULTIM8® HubMate™ Microfiber Cleaning Tool is the perfect companion for maintaining the cleanliness and performance of your ULTIM8 SmartHub. Designed with versatility in mind, this innovative tool allows you to easily clean the inside of the SmartHub while the detachable microfiber cloth ensures a thorough clean for every surface. Keep your SmartHub hygienic and pristine with this easy-to-use cleaning solution.

Key Features & Benefits:


• Custom Fit for the ULTIM8 SmartHub: Specifically designed to clean every nook and cranny of your SmartHub with ease and precision.
• Versatile Microfiber Cloth: Use the attached microfiber cloth with the tool to clean the inside of the SmartHub, or detach it from the handle to reach and clean other areas.
• Gentle Yet Effective Cleaning: The soft, non-abrasive microfiber material removes residue and dirt without scratching or damaging surfaces.
• Easy to Maintain: The microfiber cloth is reusable and machine washable, making cleanup simple and sustainable.
• Ergonomic Design: Lightweight and easy to handle, the HubMate ensures effortless cleaning every time.
• Prolongs SmartHub Performance: Regular cleaning with the ULTIM8 HubMate helps maintain your SmartHub’s functionality and extends its life.

FAQs
items.html:
Whats is the ULTIM8 HubMate Microfiber Cleaning Tool Used for?
The HubMate is specifically designed to clean and maintain your ULTIM8® SmartHub. It ensures your SmartHub stays spotless and functional by thoroughly cleaning both the inside and outside surfaces.
How do I clean the inside of the ULTIM8® SmartHub?
To clean the inside, first remove the top rinse cup or cap and the bottom cover. Then, insert the HubMate from either the top or bottom of the SmartHub to clean hard-to-reach areas. The versatile microfiber cloth ensures thorough cleaning while protecting delicate surfaces.
How do I clean the microfiber cloth?
The microfiber cloth is reusable and easy to maintain. Simply detach it from the handle and toss it into your washing machine. Wash on a gentle cycle and air dry for best results.
Is the microfiber cloth safe for delicate surfaces?
Yes! The HubMate microfiber cloth is soft, non-abrasive, and perfect for cleaning surfaces without scratching or damaging them, ensuring your SmartHub remains in excellent condition.
How often should I use the HubMate to clean my ULTIM8® SmartHub?
For optimal performance, we recommend cleaning your SmartHub with the HubMate once a week or as needed, especially in areas prone to residue or buildup.

reviews.title: Kiss Bad Breath Goodbye—The ULTIM8 Upgrade Your Mouth Deserves.
reviews.body:
The ULTIM8 HubMate Microfiber Cleaning Tool is one of those "how did I live without this?" additions to a daily routine. While most people focus on the brush, the HubMate is the unsung hero that keeps the whole system hygienic and looking sleek.

Why it’s great:
Precision Cleaning: It’s specifically shaped to get into the nooks and crannies of the charging base and the brush handle that standard towels just can't reach.

Superior Material: The high-density microfiber lifts away toothpaste residue and water spots without scratching the premium finish of the SmartBrush.

Quick Drying: It doesn't stay damp, which is crucial for preventing that "bathroom mildew" smell common with cheap cloths.

Bottom Line: If you're investing in a high-end SmartBrush system, the HubMate is essential for protecting that investment and keeping your countertop looking spotless.
